use default

sigma(value: int) -> int is
    let total mut = 0
    let divisor mut = 1

    while divisor * divisor <= value do
        if value % divisor == 0 then
            total = total + divisor

            let partner = value / divisor

            if partner != divisor then
                total = total + partner
            fi
        fi

        divisor = divisor + 1
    od

    total
si

gcd(a: int, b: int) -> int => if b == 0 then a else gcd(b, a % b) fi

is_composite(value: int) -> bool is
    let divisor mut = 2

    while divisor * divisor <= value do
        if value % divisor == 0 then return true fi
        divisor = divisor + 1
    od

    false
si

is_duffinian(value: int) -> bool =>
    is_composite(value) /\ gcd(value, sigma(value)) == 1

duffinians() -> Pipe[int] is
    let candidate mut = 1

    do
        candidate = candidate + 1

        if is_duffinian(candidate) then
            yield candidate
        fi
    od
si

triplets() -> Pipe[int] is
    let candidate mut = 1

    do
        candidate = candidate + 1

        if is_duffinian(candidate) /\
           is_duffinian(candidate + 1) /\
           is_duffinian(candidate + 2)
        then
            yield candidate
        fi
    od
si

write_line("the first fifty Duffinian numbers:")

let first_fifty =
    duffinians() |> take(50) |> map(v => "{v,5}") |> collect_list()

for row in 0..5 do
    write_line(first_fifty[row * 10..row * 10 + 10] |> join(""))
od

write_line("")
write_line("the first fifteen Duffinian triplets:")

for start in triplets() |> take(15) do
    write_line("  {start} {start + 1} {start + 2}")
od
